label: From Cartesian to vector form
subgoals: Fix point P0 on the line
Attach direction vector v at P0

label: Parametric form
subgoals: Split P = P0 + t v into coordinates
Read x = x0 + t vx per axis
Vary t across R to trace the line

label: Example
subgoals: Plug t = 1 to step one v forward
Check the traced point against y = mx + q
